title: Turkish Delight Baklava
description: A classic Turkish dessert made with layers of phyllo, nuts, and marzipan, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, mix together the walnuts, marzipan, honey, cardamom, and cinnamon.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Brush each piece of phyllo with melted butter.
Place a portion of the nut mixture onto one half of each piece of phyllo.
Fold the other half of the phyllo over the filling to form a triangle.
Place the triangles on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with powdered sugar if desired.
